highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 combines Skia m154 with packaged API documentation and synchronized HarfBuzz bindings.
highlights_body: NuGet packages carry compiler XML beside implementation and reference assemblies. Review the HarfBuzz enum migrations and the removal of RAW/DNG decoding before upgrading.

breaking.title: Update HarfBuzz enum references
breaking.body: Replace UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 with CCC132; its numeric value remains 132 and no alias is retained. GlyphFlags.Defined is removed: combine the concrete glyph flags your code requires instead. Aggregate BufferFlags.Defined and SerializeFlag.Defined masks are not exposed.

breaking.title: Decode RAW and DNG outside SkiaSharp
breaking.body: Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of JPEG previews from RAW containers are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode or convert these files with another library before using SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains value 10 for compatibility but no longer indicates codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged.

bullets.detail: Updates the renderer to m154, including Ganesh clipping, Graphite triangle-strip, SVG color-filter, and Skottie text-tracking changes. HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400 remains based on native HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

Ships source-authored compiler XML beside both lib and ref assemblies so consumer-visible reference assemblies have matching API documentation. Implementation-only error-obsolete members remain unavailable for compilation.
Synchronizes supported buffer, cluster, glyph, and baseline-tag values with the bundled HarfBuzz revision without adding new managed types or callback-heavy API families.

Corrects partial glyph-atlas generation tracking, propagates native Ganesh failures, rejects incomplete GPU buffer uploads, and clears uniquely held cache entries after failed flushes. Existing null/false/invalid-result contracts remain in use; managed flush signatures stay void.
The Uno views package depends on matching HarfBuzz WebAssembly assets, preventing link failures caused by combining newer managed imports with an older native archive.

Removes command-line truncation-warning suppression from libHarfBuzzSharp so dependent applications no longer need a BinSkim BA2007 baseline for that DLL. Other reported BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Corrected Windows HarfBuzz warning suppression so dependent applications pass the BinSkim BA2007 gate.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 introduced the Skia m154 engine and the HarfBuzzSharp .400 package revision without upgrading native HarfBuzz.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11: Preview 2 added packaged compiler XML and synchronized HarfBuzz enum values, including source migrations. It also corrected Uno native-asset alignment, Windows HarfBuzz BA2007 compliance, and GPU atlas and upload handling.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14: Release Candidate 1 retired built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded JPEG preview extraction; the public Dng enum value remains for compatibility.

harfbuzz_summary: Bindings now follow the bundled HarfBuzz 14.2.1 source, including supported enum additions, CCC132 in place of CCC133, and removal of GlyphFlags.Defined. Packages carry compiler XML, and the Windows native DLL passes BinSkim BA2007; these changes are not a native HarfBuzz version upgrade.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine.

v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11.headline: Preview 2 adds packaged API documentation and synchronized HarfBuzz enums with migration requirements.

v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14.headline: Release Candidate 1 retires built-in RAW and DNG decoding.

v4.154.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 adds failed-flush GPU cache cleanup to the release candidate.
